hero.lede: Dashboards, charts, topology, maps and Mermaid diagrams from your data, written straight to SVG, PNG, HTML, email or Markdown. No browser, no JavaScript runtime and no package dependencies, from .NET or PowerShell.

surfaces.label: C#
surfaces.caption: The chart definition. Save it as SVG, PNG or HTML from the same object.

surfaces.label: SVG
surfaces.caption: Vector output with an accessible name and description. Its colors are CSS custom properties, so this chart follows the page's theme switch.

surfaces.label: PNG
surfaces.caption: Native PNG from the same layout. No browser, no headless Chrome and no System.Drawing.

surfaces.label: HTML
surfaces.caption: A self-contained page with no script. Switch to interactive to see the optional ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html adapter on the same chart.

surfaces.label: Email
surfaces.caption: Mail clients get the PNG, with the chart's text alternative as its alt text.

surfaces.label: Markdown
surfaces.caption: The same chart authored as a fenced block. ChartForgeX.Markup parses it into the same chart model.

facts.title: No runtime package dependencies
facts.body: The core package ships alone. Browser behaviour lives in opt-in adapter packages.

facts.title: .NET Framework 4.7.2 to .NET 10
facts.body: Every package targets net472, netstandard2.0, net8.0 and net10.0.

facts.title: Native AOT and trimming
facts.body: Trim and AOT analyzers are on, and a Native AOT smoke test runs in the release loop.

facts.title: Deterministic output
facts.body: The same input renders the same SVG and PNG, ready for snapshot tests and cached reports.

beyond.title: Dashboards and report grids
beyond.body: Compose charts, KPI tiles and tables into one canvas with ChartGrid and VisualGrid.
beyond.alt: Restaurant operations dashboard with revenue trend, order status, customer distribution and occupation charts in a dark report grid.

beyond.title: Topology and maps
beyond.body: Layered, grouped and geographic layouts with route arcs, region hulls and icon packs.
beyond.alt: Geographic topology map with sites connected by route arcs across regions.

beyond.title: Region and dotted maps
beyond.body: Region, tile and dotted maps with numeric color scales and a built-in map catalog.
beyond.alt: Map of Europe with countries shaded by revenue.

beyond.title: Hierarchies
beyond.body: Organization charts, sunbursts and treemaps with stable IDs for drill-down hosts.
beyond.alt: Team hierarchy diagram with managers and reports arranged as a tree.

beyond.title: Graph explorer
beyond.body: Browse large hierarchies and meshes in the browser with SVG, Canvas or WebGL rendering from ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html.
beyond.alt: Interactive graph explorer showing a replication mesh between directory sites.

cells: Capture an image with a headless browser
Render with mermaid-cli, which drives a headless browser
SVG or PNG, or editable Visio shapes through OfficeIMO
Ship a script bundle that draws on load

packages.use: Charts, chart grids, topology, maps, prepared scenes and still-image output.
Visual canvases, image composition, KPI tiles, tables, lists and watermarks.
Animated visual and terminal stories with GIF and APNG output.
Parse Mermaid source and render it through the native engine.
Markdown fences for charts, timelines, topology, flows, sequences and tables.
Self-contained interactive pages: tooltips, topology explorer and graph explorer.

family.name: PowerBGInfo
family.body: Machine facts, health and charts on desktop and lock-screen wallpapers, rendered by ChartForgeX from PowerShell.

family.name: OfficeIMO
family.body: Place ChartForgeX visuals in Office documents, or project them as editable Visio shapes, through the OfficeIMO.ChartForgeX adapter.

family.name: CanopyX
family.body: Interactive trees and data grids for the tables that sit next to your charts.

family.name: CodeGlyphX
family.body: QR codes and barcodes in pure .NET, for report footers, labels and tickets.

family.name: HtmlForgeX
family.body: Build HTML reports, dashboards and emails in C# around your charts.

family.name: ImagePlayground
family.body: PowerShell commands for charts, QR codes and image processing, built on ChartForgeX and CodeGlyphX.

showcases.title: SaaS revenue and retention dashboard
showcases.summary: Monthly recurring revenue, movement drivers, churn context, and supporting KPI cards composed into one deterministic dashboard.
showcases.alt: SaaS dashboard showing monthly recurring revenue, MRR drivers, customer movement, churn, and supporting KPI cards in a dark grid.

showcases.title: Security posture radar
showcases.summary: A dark-theme radar chart for comparing posture across identity, endpoint, data, network, application, and operational dimensions.
showcases.alt: Dark radar chart comparing security posture scores across six security dimensions with a filled polygon and labeled axes.

showcases.title: Geographic infrastructure topology
showcases.summary: A topology-native geographic layout with projected site markers, curved WAN routes, regional callouts, selection state, and metadata hooks.
showcases.alt: World topology map with regional infrastructure sites, curved WAN connections, status labels, and an APAC site selected for detail.

showcases.title: Control coverage matrix
showcases.summary: A heatmap that compares security domains across controls with semantic colors, readable labels, and an explicit value scale.
showcases.alt: Dark security control coverage heatmap with domain rows, control columns, colored cells, percentage labels, and a semantic value scale.

showcases.title: Europe revenue map
showcases.summary: A dotted geographic map that encodes regional revenue with value-colored points, labels, and a report-oriented viewport.
showcases.alt: Light map of Europe with country and city labels, colored revenue markers, and a legend explaining the value scale.

surfaces2.description: Charts, timelines, topology and tables as fenced blocks in your docs.

surfaces2.name: Mermaid
surfaces2.description: Mermaid diagrams rendered without a browser, with explicit syntax and layout limits.

surfaces2.name: Browser
surfaces2.description: Optional interactive pages: tooltips, zoom, topology and graph explorers.
